ConsentModal.callToAction: Please confirm that you understand and agree to this responsibility.
ConsentModal.content:
As a coach using CoachBot Studio, you are the primary Data Controller for the end-customer data you process within your coaching relationship. This means you are responsible for ensuring all data is handled with the utmost care and in full compliance with all relevant data protection regulations (like GDPR).

CoachBot Studio acts as your Data Processor for specific services, such as appointment scheduling. Our obligations and your responsibilities for this particular processing are detailed in the <link>Data Processing Agreement (DPA)</link> between you and us. By clicking "I Consent," you confirm you've read, understood, and agreed to the DPA's terms for these specific services.

Please be aware that any misuse, unauthorized sharing, or careless handling of personal data under your responsibility could lead to the immediate termination of your coaching relationship with us and/or severe legal consequences.
ConsentModal.title: Coach Data Responsibility & Consent

generalKnowledge.title: General Knowledge
generalKnowledge.subTitle: General Knowledge provides automatic access to broad background information without needing specific citations. The system draws on this built-in expertise to offer contextually relevant guidance and insights.

specificReference.title: Specific References
specificReference.subTitle: Specific References allow you to point to particular uploaded documents using the <reference> tag in prompts:

options.point1: To reference the entire document: <reference type="full" document="File Name.pdf" />
options.point2: To reference a specific section by title: <reference type="section" document="File Name.pdf" section="Chapter 1: Generation" />
options.point3: To reference specific pages: <reference type="pages" document="File Name.pdf" pages="3-5" />

common.subTitle: When using General Knowledge, the system leverages its comprehensive understanding to provide responses. When precision matters, Specific References ensure information is drawn directly from your exact source materials.
